title: Grupo Frontera Takes Home Two Latin Grammys, Including Best Norteño Album
excerpt: The South Texas group won Best Norteño Album for "Lo Que Me Falta Por Llorar" and Best Regional Song for "No Capea," its collaboration with Xavi, at the 27th Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas on Nov. 12.
content:
Grupo Frontera added two more trophies to its career at the 27th Latin Grammy Awards in Las Vegas, winning Best Norteño Album for Lo Que Me Falta Por Llorar and Best Regional Song for "No Capea," its collaboration with Xavi, according to LaMezcla.

The South Texas group went into the November 12 ceremony at the MGM Grand Garden Arena with three nominations, including a second Best Regional Song nomination for "Ojitos Bellos," and came away with two wins, according to the report.

The Best Norteño Album win marks the group's return to a category it previously won in 2024 for El Comienzo, according to LaMezcla.

Beyond the awards, the group delivered one of the night's most distinctive performances, singing "Coqueta" and "Ojitos Bellos" with a live orchestral ensemble in a stage concept called Palenque Frontera, inspired by the traditional palenques of Mexican fairs and live regional music, according to the report.

The awards cap a year in which the group has played more than 60 dates on its Triste Pero Bien C*brón Tour across the United States, Mexico, Central America, South America and Europe, including first-time shows in London, Zurich and Milan, according to LaMezcla.

The group is set to perform at Coca-Cola Flow Fest on November 28 in Mexico City, then close the tour with three sold-out shows at Arena Monterrey on December 16, 17 and 18, on a 360-degree stage, according to the report.

Source: LaMezcla, November 15, 2026.
